wm_early_hook.admission_required_before: Before wmEvent event,*event_state initialization or at least before any Trackpad shared xy write/coalescing; place dedicated typed-provenance check at the entry-side guard region.
wm_early_hook.mutation: Trackpad branch copies native-converted pd x/y into event_state->xy; wm_event_add_trackpad coalesces same-type prior queued event by freeing/replacing it. A late wm_event_do_handlers filter does not undo those effects.
wm_early_hook.identity_absent: Current GHOST_EventTrackpad PAN constructor supplies no Pencil actor/contact serial/origin/pair token. numFingers1 is also ordinary Finger/indirect scroll; it cannot authorize suppression.

same_batch_first_down.consequence: CURSOR/DOWN/PAN/CURSOR from one or several UIKit actions can all be converted/queued before the first DOWN invokes native Knife and registers its modal handler. A guard requiring an already-live Knife at GHOST ingestion misses this case. Source ordering is proved; actual UIKit coalescing/timing is not.

smallest_coherent_direction.scope: Suppression only of the explicitly paired one-finger PAN from a physical Pencil Knife canvas contact; ordinary precision cursor/down/up positions/count/order, translation cache, tablet snapshots, modifiers and terminal semantics stay exact.
smallest_coherent_direction.preferred_bound: Dedicated value-only original contact/Knife canvas intent captured before superclass physical Begin, with completed actual presentation and fresh native validation immediately before recognition admits omission. Current Knife presentation hierarchy can supply completed higher-layer evidence but does not itself capture first-invocation active-tool intent.
smallest_coherent_direction.not_ready: Existing value registry alone cannot prove pre-recognition invalidation for tool/screen/layout/popup changes or A->B->A. Either prove the concrete invalidation/lifecycle coverage or validate a frozen original receipt through a callback-free native bridge; no source for either exists.
smallest_coherent_direction.wm_alternative: Would require explicit Pencil/pair provenance and admission before Trackpad state/coalescing, plus an exact pending-first-DOWN policy. It cannot be implemented as a late live-handler filter or numFingers check. Pending DOWN must not be assumed to invoke Knife through arbitrary native keymap/poll/admission.
smallest_coherent_direction.first_invocation_native_parity: Default Knife toolbar maps plain tool_mouse PRESS to mesh.knife_tool(wait_for_input=False), without any modifier wildcard. Preserve initial modified-down native keymap behavior; never force Knife or clear Ctrl. A later Ctrl press while cutting remains accepted native ignore-snap behavior.
